io.reader

Class ExcelHandler

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.xml.sax.helpers.DefaultHandler
      • io.reader.ExcelHandler
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    org.xml.sax.ContentHandler, org.xml.sax.DTDHandler, org.xml.sax.EntityResolver, org.xml.sax.ErrorHandler

    class ExcelHandler
extends org.xml.sax.helpers.DefaultHandler
    Parses worksheet XML from an XLSX workbook using SAX events.

    Cell values are converted to strings and accumulated into row arrays. Shared strings are resolved through the supplied shared-strings table. Numeric values are formatted using worksheet styles when a styles table is available.

    Formula cells use their cached results stored in the workbook. This handler does not evaluate formulas. Although XML parsing is event-driven, parsed rows are retained in memory in rowCache.

      • characters

        public void characters(char[] ch,
                       int start,
                       int length)
                throws org.xml.sax.SAXException
        Appends a SAX character-data chunk to the current cell value.

        SAX may deliver the text of a single XML element in multiple chunks, so each chunk is appended to the buffer.

        Specified by:
        characters in interface org.xml.sax.ContentHandler
        Overrides:
        characters in class org.xml.sax.helpers.DefaultHandler
        Parameters:
        ch - character buffer supplied by the SAX parser
        start - offset of the first character
        length - number of characters to append
        Throws:
        org.xml.sax.SAXException - if SAX processing fails

      • endElement

        public void endElement(java.lang.String uri,
                       java.lang.String localName,
                       java.lang.String qname)
                throws org.xml.sax.SAXException
        Processes the end of an XML element.

        Cell values are resolved and appended to the current row. At the end of a row, trailing padding is added when required and the completed row is cached.

      • readCellFormat

        private void readCellFormat(java.lang.String styleText)
        Resolves a cell's style index into its number-format index and format string.

        If the style cannot be resolved, the raw cell value is retained rather than applying a potentially incorrect format.

        It also converts common US-style date patterns to a standardised Australian day/month/year time format.

        Parameters:
        styleText - style index from the cell's s attribute
